approval.decisionReference: Tyler's explicit approval in CapitolWonk recovery chat 01a140c5-9929-7903-805a-90f67d679ff8 on 2026-10-15: apply reviewed seven-file patch SHA-256 11d5437b0134658277edee0da7b9c1b2513fee84461c7a79886c680a0a526bc8, accept the documented temporary exception and run Linux CI; stop on unrelated drift; no merge or deployment.

rationale: No published fixed version exists in the reviewed advisory. The locally pinned depth guard mitigates tested excessive-depth string and AST-nodes recursion for the reviewed build-tool consumers. Current globs are fixed configuration strings; no deployed request path was identified. This is conditional residual-risk acceptance, not a false-positive claim or a clean audit.

evidence.sandboxResults: 36 depth cases rejected; 764 upstream tests passed; 12950 differential comparisons matched; identical Tailwind CSS; application lint and 57-page build passed on macOS arm64 with Node 22.22.3/pnpm 9.15.9.
evidence.auditResults: Authorized unfiltered full audit: exit 1, one high (this advisory), four moderate, zero critical. Audit path/dev metadata is not used as proof of development-only scope.
evidence.linuxCandidateValidation: Historical validation completed: Linux CI #475 attempt 1 passed for PR #60 head a1d58fede94c273ae1f8113911a35b7fd7491382. It passed 163 regressions, installed mitigation/development-scope verification, a fresh 57-page build and final raw-audit exception enforcement. Retained evidence and limits are documented in docs/security/braces-linux-ci-475-evidence-2026-10-15.json. The audit still reports one accepted high and four moderate findings; this is not release clearance. This narrative reconciliation changes the record fingerprint and requires fresh CI if applied; #475 does not validate a later documentation commit.

residualRisks: Malformed caller-supplied AST parent cycles and deeply array-valued text remain unsafe; reviewed consumers supply strings, not those ASTs.
The guard is not an expansion-cardinality, general AST-width, getter, CPU or memory bound.
Controlled SyntaxError may fail a build when propagated; this does not promise acceptance of malicious input.
No automated scan proves all possible dataflow safe. Relevant source, configuration and trust-boundary changes require human review.
The local guard is not an upstream-maintainer-approved security release.
controls: Frozen installation; exact manifest/lock/config/patch hashes; installed library hashes; exactly four reviewed development paths; no production graph path.
Fresh Linux build traces must exclude braces, micromatch, fast-glob, chokidar and tailwindcss; application imports of those tools require reassessment.
Keep production audit and manual audit:full unchanged; no pnpm ignore list or raised severity threshold. Full raw JSON and explicit accepted-high disposition are retained in CI artifacts.

Every unrelated high/critical, registry/parse/transport failure, missing mitigation, schema change, expiry, review deadline or scope drift fails closed. The final gate queries npm's public latest braces version; any change from 3.0.3 requires reassessment even before the advisory database catches up.
Keep pull-request builds unprivileged (contents: read), no production-secret injection, and the existing 25-minute job timeout. No privileged pull_request_target trigger is introduced.
reviewAndRemoval: Review by the end of October 22 Pacific; the first following midnight blocks CI. Absolute expiry is the end of October 29 Pacific. No automatic renewal. A changed advisory, published patched version, production path, dependency/config change or different patch invalidates the exception. Replace with a validated official release and explicitly remove the local patch/exception machinery in a separately reviewed change; a disappearing finding fails closed to prompt that cleanup.
approvalBoundary: APPROVED SOURCE-ONLY EXCEPTION. Tyler's original residual-risk approval is recorded above; the guard/enforcement changes and separately approved billing-readiness compatibility correction were applied to the isolated branch and published to draft PR #60. Approval metadata, scope and deadlines remain unchanged. Fields are an approval record, not cryptographic authentication; repository review/protection must prevent unauthorized policy edits. The raw audit:full and strict release-candidate gates remain unchanged. No branch-protection change, protected runtime activation, merge or deployment is authorized by this record or by green exception-aware CI.
recovery: The guard/enforcement changes are applied on the isolated review branch; no merge or deployment was performed in this workflow. To withdraw the temporary exception, revert the guard and accepting enforcement together in a separately authorized change to restore the raw full-audit blocker; never remove the guard while leaving an accepting exception. Reverting only the billing-readiness compatibility correction restores its prior fail-closed CI-coverage blocker without removing the braces guard. No production rollback follows automatically.
